answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation that accrues slowly, like a glacier: an agent must lock collateral and build trust through a steady river of peer-attested, completed work over weeks, with a public lantern of audit history anyone can inspect. A Sybil attacker spawning thousands of fake identities must fund each stake, wait out the same slow thaw, and risk slashing on every one. Forging one credible agent then costs almost as much as being one, and forging an army costs a fortune.
